senses.gloss: ch. same, to go up. Impf. יִסַּק, יֵיסַק; inf. מִיסַּק, מֵיסַק; imper. סַק, סוּק.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 5:22">Targ. II Sam. V, 22</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 20:19">Targ. O. Num. XX, 19</cite> <cite ref="N00957"><he>נֵיסָּק</he></cite> ed. Berl.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 44:17">Targ. Gen. XLIV, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 50a:10">Kidd. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>אדעתא למֵיסַק וכ׳</he> with the idea of going up to Palestine.

<cite ref="Beitzah 27a:6">Bets. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>אזכי ואִסַּק</he>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 22a">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ואֵיסק</he> (not <he>ואסיק</he>), a. e., v. <cite ref="G00456"><he>זְכֵי</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to rise, to bring up, offer.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:9">Targ. Lev. II, 9</cite>, a. fr. (h. text <cite ref="S00823"><he>הקטיר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 6:2">Targ. II Sam. VI, 2</cite> <he>לַאֲסָקָא</he> ed. Wil.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:3">Targ. Lev. XI, 3</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—
Targ. Josh. XVII, 13 מַסְקֵי מסין tributaries.—Y. Keth. XI, 34ᵇ bot. והוה מַסֵּיק לון מזונין וכ׳ and he offered them support as long as they lived.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אַסְּקֵיה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00156"><he>נְגִידָא</he> III</cite>. Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ <he>אַסְּקוּנֵיה למאתים וכ׳</he> they raised the offer to two hundred, to one thousand; Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ top <he>אַסְּקִינֵיה</he>. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, end, 55ᶜ <he>מַסִּיק חסין</he> will produce lettuce; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (sub. בישרא) to produce new flesh, to heal.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 69a:13">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>לאַסּוּקֵי וכ׳</he> for healing let him take &c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 2:6">Targ. Koh. II, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 39a:1">Succ. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אַסּוּקֵי מילתא</he> the winding up of a proceeding; <cite ref="Yevamot 106b">Yeb. 106ᵇ</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>אפסוקי</he>).

senses.gloss: (with בִּשְׁמָא) to name after, to adopt a name.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 38b:4">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מַסְּקִינָן בשמייהו</he> we do not name children after them.
<cite ref="Gittin 11b:2">Gitt. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא שכיחי ישראל דמַסְּקֵי בשמהתייהו</he> names which Israelites are not in the habit of adopting.
<cite ref="Shevuot 29a">Shebu. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ואסיק להו</he> (<he>שמא</he>) <he>זוזי</he> and named them coins; a. e.

senses.gloss: (with זוזי, a. ב of person) to produce a claim against.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 41b:13-14">Shebu. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>הב לי … דמַסִּיקְנָא בך</he> give me the one hundred Zuz which I claim against thee (which thou owest me).
<cite ref="Ketubot 85a:4">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו מַסְּקֵּי ביה זוזי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00285"><he>חוֹזָאֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a:5">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>אינשי דמסיק בהו זוזי</he> persons against whom he had a claim; a. e.
<cite ref="Shevuot 29a:12">Shebu. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>דמסקי אדעתייהו וכ׳</he> they might have in mind an idol.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:12">Targ. O. Lev. II, 12</cite> <he>יִתַּסְּקוּן</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <he>יְתַסְקוּן</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:21">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 21</cite>; a. e.
